new_gates.GP0: Real offline CLI produces consistent artifacts for normal, empty, parse-error, blocked and budget-limited runs with zero provider requests.
new_gates.GP1: All enabled capability acceptance checks and retained admission positive/negative controls execute and pass.
new_gates.GP2: Conditional: scratch/native remain unavailable until their approved owned-fixture capability gates pass.
new_gates.GP3: Not measured: authorized real tasks require paired human review timing, fact-error counts and actionable missing-obligation assessment.
new_gates.GP4: Not measured: optional model explanation must improve paired quality or review effort at explicitly reported additional cost. No benefit is a valid result.

sample_admission.scope: Fresh project-owned or explicitly authorized local source; no third-party execution or payload generation.
sample_admission.labels: Private evaluator records never enter detector prompts, aliases or source selection.

invariants: Freeze source, property contracts, admitted context and baseline evidence before paired assessment.
Explanation may reference accepted evidence and gaps but cannot change property states.
Balance arm order across reviewers; use repository-level paired summaries and retain exclusions.
Record review seconds, fact errors, correct missing-obligation identification, actionability, all requests, reported usage, unknown usage and wall time.
Separate replay savings from live costs; confidence is not probability of correctness.
Planner/Jev/multiple experts require a separately preregistered reproducible net benefit before product inclusion.
component_decision_now: The default product keeps models/planner/Jev/quorum/early-stop/target execution disabled; original research profiles and artifacts remain available as historical research.
